collapse-at.description:
CSS length below which navigation collapses and single-row app bars can center their title.
`none` never collapses: links that do not fit wrap onto more lines.

heading-level.description: Native heading level for the screen title. Use 1 through 6 to fit the page outline.

label.description: Accessible name of the header's primary navigation landmark. Override for localization.

navigation-label.description: Accessible name for the compact navigation button and menu. Override for localization.

overflow-label.description: Accessible name for the app-bar overflow button and menu. Override for localization.

scroll-behavior.description: Tint on scroll with elevate, also shrink tall bars with collapse, or opt out with none.

size.description: Bar size. Only app-bar mode has large and extra-large two-row sizes.

sticky.description: Keep the bar at the block start of the scroll container and draw a bottom border.

subtitle.description: Supporting text displayed under the screen heading.

title.description: Screen heading, set with the HTML title attribute or the screenTitle property.

title-align.description: Center a compact single-row title when the app bar has at most one action.

variant.description: Header for primary navigation, or app-bar for the current screen. Defaults to header.

--ki-app-bar-backdrop-filter.description: Filter applied to the entire app-bar backdrop.

--ki-app-bar-bg-image.description: Optional image above the app-bar fill.

--ki-app-bar-fg.description: Resting app-bar title and control ink.

--ki-app-bar-height.description: Height of a normal or collapsed app bar.

--ki-app-bar-lg-height.description: Expanded height of a large app bar.

--ki-app-bar-scrolled-bg.description: App-bar fill when its container scrolls.

--ki-app-bar-scrolled-fg.description: App-bar title and control ink when its container scrolls.

--ki-app-bar-scrolled-subtitle-fg.description: App-bar subtitle ink when its container scrolls.

--ki-app-bar-xl-height.description: Expanded height of an extra-large app bar.

--ki-density-target-min.description: The smallest pointer target any density may produce: 24 x 24 CSS px by default and in compact (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), 44 x 44 in touch (WCAG 2.5.5). It floors a shrinking control but never lifts what a control paints: a control painted smaller extends its target to it, invisibly; rows and tabs grow to it (spec 045 A1).

--ki-focus-ring-color.description: Colour of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws: 3:1 or more against the page in every theme and scheme.

--ki-focus-ring-offset.description: Gap between a focusable component and its keyboard focus ring.

--ki-focus-ring-width.description: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws (its outline). One token instead of one per component, so a mode or a theme changes every ring at once.

--ki-layout-border-width.description: Hairline edge on a structural surface.

--ki-layout-indicator-width.description: Thickness of the line identifying a selected navigation destination.

--ki-layout-spacing-12xl.description: The 12xl spacing step for a stack or grid gap.

--ki-layout-spacing-7xl.description: The 7xl spacing step for a stack or grid gap.

--ki-layout-spacing-xl.description: The xl spacing step for a stack or grid gap.

--ki-layout-spacing-xs.description: The xs spacing step for a stack or grid gap.

--ki-layout-touch-target.description: Minimum target dimension for navigation controls on a coarse pointer.

--ki-motion-duration-medium-1.description: M3 md.sys.motion.duration.medium1 (250ms). onmars: MarsUI moderate step (240ms, 2x the 120ms base).

--ki-text-low-em.description: semantic color for text low em. Not an ink for body text: under 4.5:1 on the light surfaces (s0-s2). Use it for large text (24px, or 18.66px bold), icons and decoration; body text takes the high-em ink of the tone.

--ki-top-nav-backdrop-filter.description: Filter applied to the entire header backdrop.

--ki-top-nav-bg-image.description: Optional image above the header fill.

--ki-top-nav-border.description: Edge color for sticky bars and menus.

--ki-top-nav-fg.description: Application header brand and control ink.

--ki-top-nav-height.description: Height of a normal application header.

--ki-top-nav-height-compact.description: Height of a small application header.

--ki-top-nav-indicator.description: Bar marking the current primary destination.

--ki-top-nav-item-hover-bg.description: Hovered control or highlighted menu item surface.

--ki-top-nav-item-hover-fg.description: Hovered control or highlighted menu item ink.

--ki-top-nav-padding-inline.description: Padding at the inline edges of both bars.

--ki-typography-family-body.description: semantic font family for typography family body.

--ki-typography-line-height-body-1.description: semantic dimension for typography line height body 1.

--ki-typography-line-height-heading-2.description: semantic dimension for typography line height heading 2.

--ki-typography-line-height-title-2.description: semantic dimension for typography line height title 2.

--ki-typography-size-body-1.description: semantic dimension for typography size body 1.

--ki-typography-size-title-2.description: semantic dimension for typography size title 2.

--ki-typography-visually-hidden-size.description: Nonzero edge for clipped text available to assistive technology.

--ki-typography-weight-body-medium.description: semantic font weight for typography weight body medium.

--ki-typography-weight-body-semibold.description: semantic font weight for typography weight body semibold.

--ki-typography-weight-display-semibold.description: semantic font weight for typography weight display semibold.

component.description:
Application navigation with responsive primary links, or a per-screen app
bar with a real heading, optional search, and overflow actions.

leading.description: Wrapper for the app-bar leading control.

links.description: Wrapper for the primary links, including when displayed as a menu.

menu.description: Anchored navigation or overflow menu surface.

menu-item.description: Generated screen action in the overflow menu.

menu-trigger.description: Native button opening collapsed navigation or overflow.

search.description: Wrapper for the app-bar search control.

subtitle.description: Supporting text below the screen heading.

slots.description:
Header mode: up to five direct native anchors; mark the current one with
aria-current="page". They stay the page's own anchors, so the page's link
rules reach them and outrank the bar's link styles (CSS Scoping gives the
page's styles precedence over a component's `::slotted()` rules, whatever
their specificity). `a { color: inherit }` is safe: the links then take the
bar's item ink. A rule that sets `color`, `text-decoration`, `font-*` or
`padding` on every `a` restyles them too: scope it away from the bar, for
example `:where(main, footer) a` or `a:not(ki-top-nav > a)`, and restyle the
bar's links with the `--ki-top-nav-item-*` tokens.

actions.description: Header: global actions. App bar: up to three inline; additional direct named buttons or links go into overflow.

brand.description:
Header mode: the brand link or wordmark. Page link rules reach it
as they reach the primary links.

leading.description: App bar: a named Back or Open navigation control.

search.description: App bar: an accessible search control that can shrink inside its row.
